name: Matterport3D
title: Matterport3D: Learning from RGB-D Data in Indoor Environments

license.en: Matterport3D Terms of Use; signed agreement and institutional-email access request. Repository MIT applies to code.
license.zh: 数据适用 Matterport3D 使用条款；签署协议并通过机构邮箱申请。仓库 MIT 仅适用于代码。

summary.en: Real building scans underpin many panoramic depth benchmarks; raw RGB-D capture and rendered ERP derivatives require different loaders.
summary.zh: 真实建筑扫描是许多全景深度基准的基础；原始 RGB-D 采集与渲染 ERP 派生集需要分别处理。

en.Projection and inputs: Three RGB-D sensors capture 18 views per tripod station; skyboxes and calibrated perspective images are provided. Published ERP depth protocols are derived products.
en.Depth and validity: Original 16-bit depth is camera Z: meters = value / 4000; zero is invalid. Do not copy this scale or Z convention to rendered ERP range.
en.Geometry and annotations: Sensor depth, reconstructed meshes, region/object semantics, intrinsics and camera-to-world poses; pose translations are meters.
en.Timing and calibration: Per-view intrinsics/extrinsics are supplied. Rotating static scan stations are not continuous synchronized VIO sequences.
en.Evaluation: Keep building identities separated. State whether using native depth, 3D60, Pano3D, or another ERP renderer and its mask/crop.

zh.投影与输入: 每站由三个 RGB-D 传感器采集 18 个视图，提供天空盒及标定透视图。论文常用的 ERP 深度协议属于派生产品。
zh.深度与有效性: 原始 16 位深度是相机 Z：米数＝数值 / 4000；0 无效。不能直接把该缩放和 Z 定义套用于渲染 ERP 径向深度。
zh.几何与标注: 包含传感器深度、重建网格、区域和物体语义、内参与相机到世界位姿；位姿平移使用米。
zh.时间与标定: 提供逐视图内外参；旋转式静态扫描站不是连续同步的 VIO 序列。
zh.评测协议: 按建筑隔离训练和测试；注明使用原始深度、3D60、Pano3D 或其他 ERP 渲染版本及掩码、裁剪。

en: Many datasets reuse these buildings; combining derivatives does not create an independent test set.
zh: 多个派生集复用这些建筑，合并后不能视为独立测试集。

name: Stanford2D3D / 2D-3D-S
title: Joint 2D-3D-Semantic Data for Indoor Scene Understanding

license.en: Dataset license agreement required; repository Apache-2.0 covers software only.
license.zh: 下载需同意数据集协议；仓库 Apache-2.0 仅覆盖软件。

summary.en: Registered indoor RGB, depth, normals, semantics and XYZ, explicitly supplied as perspective and equirectangular products.
summary.zh: 室内配准 RGB、深度、法向、语义与 XYZ，明确提供透视和等距柱状全景版本。

en.Projection and inputs: The release has data/ perspective images and pano/ ERP modalities plus raw scan views. Perspective images are 1080×1080.
en.Depth and validity: 16-bit PNG: meters = value / 512, invalid = 65535. Perspective depth is Z; panoramic depth is camera-center Euclidean distance.
en.Ground truth: Real scanned meshes generate registered 2D/2.5D products. Normals, global XYZ and semantic instances accompany depth.
en.Calibration: Pose JSON contains K, camera location and rotations. ERP metadata may say 90° FOV although the image is 360°.
en.Evaluation: Preserve area/building splits and disclose the exact fold. Panorama rotations and perspective crops from one station must remain together.

zh.投影与输入: 发布包含 data/ 透视图、pano/ ERP 各模态及原始扫描视图；透视图分辨率为 1080×1080。
zh.深度与有效性: 16 位 PNG：米数＝数值 / 512，65535 无效。透视深度是 Z；全景深度是相机中心到表面的欧氏距离。
zh.真值来源: 真实扫描网格生成配准二维及 2.5D 产品，同时提供法向、全局 XYZ 和语义实例。
zh.标定: 位姿 JSON 包含 K、相机位置和旋转。ERP 元数据可能写 90° FOV，但图像实际为 360°。
zh.评测协议: 保留区域、建筑级划分并注明具体折次；同一扫描站的全景旋转与透视裁剪必须放在同一集合。

en: Do not substitute the S3DIS point-cloud-only release for the richer 2D-3D-S release.
zh: 不能用仅点云的 S3DIS 发布替代包含丰富二维模态的 2D-3D-S。

evidence.title: Official modalities, data license and depth encoding

name: Structured3D
title: Structured3D: A Large Photo-realistic Dataset for Structured 3D Modeling

license.en: Structured3D Terms of Use and agreement form; code MIT is separate.
license.zh: 需遵守 Structured3D 数据条款并填写协议表；代码 MIT 与数据许可分开。

summary.en: Synthetic house designs provide panoramic/perspective depth with controlled lighting and furnishing, plus rich structural annotations.
summary.zh: 合成房屋设计提供全景和透视深度，可控制照明、家具，并包含丰富结构标注。

en.Projection and inputs: Separate panorama and perspective folders contain RGB, depth, normals, albedo and semantic labels. Panorama cameras are gravity-aligned.
en.Depth and validity: Unsigned 16-bit PNG in millimeters; 1000 = 1 m; zero invalid. The format page does not explicitly settle range versus Z for every projection.
en.Ground truth: Dense labels are rendered from designed geometry, not measured by a physical depth sensor; junction/line/plane relations and layouts are provided.
en.Calibration: Panorama camera_xyz uses millimeters, looks toward negative Y, with Z up. Perspective poses additionally include view/up and FOV.
en.Evaluation: Official scene IDs: 00000–02999 train, 03000–03249 validation, 03250–03499 test. Keep furniture/light variants together; use published invalid-case list.

zh.投影与输入: panorama 与 perspective 分目录存放 RGB、深度、法向、反照率和语义；全景相机与重力方向对齐。
zh.深度与有效性: 无符号 16 位 PNG，单位毫米；1000＝1 米，0 无效。格式页未明确解释所有投影的径向距离与 Z 区别。
zh.真值来源: 稠密标注由设计几何渲染，不是物理深度传感器实测；提供角点、线、平面关系与布局。
zh.标定: 全景 camera_xyz 使用毫米，朝向负 Y，Z 向上；透视位姿另含视线、上方向和 FOV。
zh.评测协议: 官方场景编号：00000–02999 训练，03000–03249 验证，03250–03499 测试。家具、照明变体不得跨集，使用官方无效样本列表。

en: A rendered metric label does not establish transfer to real panoramic cameras.
zh: 具有公制渲染标签不代表能直接迁移到真实全景相机。

evidence.title: Official depth units and camera conventions

name: Replica
title: The Replica Dataset: A Digital Replica of Indoor Spaces

license.en: Replica Dataset Research Terms: non-commercial / not-for-profit research or educational purposes.
license.zh: Replica 数据研究条款：用于非商业、非营利研究或教育目的。

summary.en: High-quality real indoor reconstructions serve as simulation assets; common RGB-D SLAM trajectories are separately rendered derivatives.
summary.zh: 高质量真实室内重建作为仿真资产；常见 RGB-D SLAM 轨迹是另外渲染的派生产品。

en.Projection and inputs: Official release centers on textured meshes and a renderer, not one fixed RGB-D sequence. Perspective frame resolution/intrinsics depend on the chosen renderer.
en.Depth and validity: Depth is rendered from reconstructed geometry. Serialization scale, range/Z and invalid pixels must be checked for the specific trajectory export.
en.Ground truth: Dense meshes, semantic/instance and plane annotations; glass/mirror metadata. Rendered poses are simulator references, not physical tracking measurements.
en.Calibration and timing: Trajectory and camera calibration are renderer inputs. No physical IMU synchronization guarantee follows from the asset release.
en.Evaluation: Name the exact sequence producer, scene list, coordinate convention and depth scale. Avoid training on the same underlying room through another derivative.

zh.投影与输入: 官方以纹理网格和渲染器为主，不是固定的一套 RGB-D 序列；透视帧分辨率、内参由渲染配置决定。
zh.深度与有效性: 深度来自重建几何渲染。序列导出的数值缩放、径向距离或 Z、无效像素规则必须逐版本核对。
zh.真值来源: 提供稠密网格、语义实例、平面及玻璃镜面信息；渲染位姿是仿真参考，不是物理跟踪测量。
zh.标定与时间: 轨迹和相机标定由渲染者设置；资产发布本身不包含物理 IMU 同步保证。
zh.评测协议: 注明序列生成者、场景清单、坐标约定和深度缩放；避免通过其他派生集训练到相同房间。

en: Replica assets, Replica360 and the popular neural-SLAM Replica trajectories are distinct releases.
zh: Replica 资产、Replica360 和常用神经 SLAM 的 Replica 轨迹是不同发布。

name: Hypersim
title: Hypersim: A Photorealistic Synthetic Dataset for Holistic Indoor Scene Understanding

license.en: Dataset CC BY-SA 3.0; original scene mesh assets require separate purchase.
license.zh: 数据集 CC BY-SA 3.0；原始场景网格资产需另外购买。

summary.en: Photorealistic synthetic indoor baseline with explicitly documented camera-center distance, a frequent source of range-versus-Z errors.
summary.zh: 照片级合成室内基线，明确记录相机中心距离，是容易出现径向距离与 Z 混用的典型数据集。

en.Projection and inputs: Perspective HDR/color renders; camera intrinsics vary, including tilt-shift parameters. This is not a native panoramic release.
en.Depth and validity: depth_meters HDF5 stores Euclidean distance in meters, not camera Z. Apply finite/valid geometric masks and the exact evaluation depth limits.
en.Geometry and scale: Normals, semantics, instances and camera trajectories accompany renders. Camera positions remain in asset units: convert using meters_per_asset_unit.
en.Evaluation: Use scene-level metadata_images_split_scene_v1.csv. Objects may be reused across different scenes; do not imply strict object-disjoint evaluation.
en.Access: Public image/annotation download script; preview JPEGs are for inspection, not a substitute for lossless HDR data.

zh.投影与输入: 透视 HDR、彩色渲染；内参按场景变化，并包含移轴参数；不是原生全景发布。
zh.深度与有效性: depth_meters HDF5 存储米制欧氏距离，不是相机 Z。需应用有限、有效几何掩码及所选评测深度范围。
zh.几何与尺度: 提供法向、语义、实例和相机轨迹。相机位置仍用资产单位，需用 meters_per_asset_unit 转换。
zh.评测协议: 使用场景级 metadata_images_split_scene_v1.csv。不同场景可能复用物体，不能声称严格物体隔离。
zh.获取方式: 提供公开图像、标注下载脚本；预览 JPEG 用于检查，不能替代无损 HDR 数据。

en: Perspective camera pixels can still encode radial range; projection alone does not determine the depth definition.
zh: 透视图像也可以存储径向距离，不能仅凭投影判断深度定义。

evidence.title: Official format, range, split and license

license.en: Underlying source-dataset agreements plus access requests; available variants have different source assets.
license.zh: 需遵守上游数据协议并申请访问；不同发布变体使用不同源资产。

summary.en: Rendered spherical panoramas and stereo offsets derived from scanned/synthetic interiors; Pano3D supersedes its monocular protocol.
summary.zh: 从扫描及合成室内场景渲染球面全景与立体偏移视点；单目协议已由 Pano3D 更新。

en.Projection and inputs: Spherical/ERP RGB with center, right and up views. Real-only variant uses Matterport3D and Stanford2D3D; original also included SunCG.
en.Depth and validity: Floating-point single-channel EXR depth; infinity denotes holes. Normal invalids include zero/NaN. Verify meter/range conversion in the selected loader.
en.Ground truth: Depth/normal supervision comes from ray tracing geometry, not an independent full-sphere sensor capture.
en.Calibration: Stereo placements are controlled rendering offsets. Cite the particular center/right/up subset and baseline; physical timing/IMU is not supplied.
en.Evaluation: Use source-scene splits. Official notice flags a rendering lighting bias; Pano3D fixes it, but currently lacks 3D60 stereo renders.

zh.投影与输入: 球面 ERP RGB，包含中心、右侧和上方视点。真实域版本用 Matterport3D 与 Stanford2D3D，早期版本还含 SunCG。
zh.深度与有效性: 单通道浮点 EXR 深度，以无穷值表示空洞；法向的无效值包括零和 NaN。米制、径向转换需核对所用加载器。
zh.真值来源: 深度、法向监督来自几何光线追踪，不是独立的整球传感器实测。
zh.标定: 立体布局是受控渲染偏移，需注明中心、右侧、上方子集与基线；不提供物理时间同步或 IMU。
zh.评测协议: 使用源场景划分。官方指出渲染照明偏差；Pano3D 修复该问题，但目前不提供 3D60 的立体渲染。

en: 3D60 and Pano3D share source scenes and are not independent captures.
zh: 3D60 与 Pano3D 共用源场景，不能作为独立采集数据。

evidence.title: Official modalities, stereo views, splits and lighting-bias notice

name: Pano3D
title: Pano3D: A Holistic Benchmark and a Solid Baseline for 360° Depth Estimation

license.en: Matterport3D and GibsonV2 terms, request form and individual Zenodo access requests.
license.zh: 遵守 Matterport3D、GibsonV2 条款，填写表单并向对应 Zenodo 资源申请访问。

summary.en: A rendered benchmark/protocol over existing scanned scenes, emphasizing spherical metrics and cross-dataset generalization.
summary.zh: 基于已有扫描场景渲染的基准与协议，重点考察球面评测及跨数据集泛化。

en.Projection and inputs: ERP RGB, depth and normals at 1024×512 or 512×256 (width×height); mono rather than 3D60 stereo offsets.
en.Ground truth: Matterport3D and GibsonV2 geometry are re-rendered. Keep renderer invalid masks; the overview alone does not fix every file's scaling convention.
en.Evaluation: M3D training / GV2 test enables transfer tests with depth-distribution, scene-context and camera-domain shifts. Use spherical-area weighted metrics.
en.Leakage and variants: Released non-test GV2 scenes may augment training; exclude the exact GV2 test split and overlapping source buildings.
en.Calibration: ERP rays and generated poses define geometry. No synchronized physical IMU stream is implied by these renders.

zh.投影与输入: ERP RGB、深度与法向，分辨率为 1024×512 或 512×256（宽×高）；提供单目而非 3D60 的立体偏移。
zh.真值来源: 重新渲染 Matterport3D 与 GibsonV2 几何。需保留渲染无效掩码；概览页不足以确定每类文件的缩放约定。
zh.评测协议: M3D 训练、GV2 测试用于深度分布、场景内容与相机域偏移评测；应采用球面面积加权指标。
zh.泄漏与变体: 发布的非测试 GV2 场景可补充训练；必须排除相应 GV2 测试划分与重复源建筑。
zh.标定: 几何由 ERP 射线与生成位姿决定，渲染发布不意味着包含同步的物理 IMU 流。

en: Pano3D is both a benchmark and baseline method; its data are not a new independently captured building corpus.
zh: Pano3D 同时是基准与基线方法，其数据不是新独立采集的建筑语料。

evidence.title: Official render protocol, access and weighted metrics

name: Gibson / GibsonV2
title: Gibson Env: Real-World Perception for Embodied Agents

zh: 真实 RGB-D 场景扫描

license.en: Scene download requires license agreement; do not equate simulator code licensing with scene-data rights.
license.zh: 场景下载需同意许可协议；仿真器代码许可不等于场景数据使用权。

summary.en: Real reconstructed indoor scenes support virtual RGB-D observations; Pano3D provides a specific GibsonV2 ERP evaluation derivative.
summary.zh: 真实重建室内场景支持虚拟 RGB-D 观测；Pano3D 提供明确的 GibsonV2 ERP 评测派生版本。

en.Projection and inputs: Perspective observations are simulator-configured; panoramic depth here refers to the documented Pano3D/GV2 derivative, not every Gibson archive.
en.Depth and validity: Depth is rendered from reconstructed meshes. Units, clipping, range/Z and resolution belong to the simulator/export protocol and must be recorded.
en.Scene quality: Static scans retain measured textures; reflective surfaces and thin structures may contain geometry irregularities.
en.Evaluation: GibsonV2 all-scenes and quality-filtered 4+ packages differ. Identify scene subset and scene-level splits; avoid overlap with Pano3D test assets.
en.Poses and timing: Simulated trajectories provide reference poses, not independently measured motion-capture GT. Physical synchronization is not an asset-level property.

zh.投影与输入: 透视观测由仿真器配置；这里的全景深度指已记录的 Pano3D/GV2 派生版，不代表所有 Gibson 压缩包均含 ERP。
zh.深度与有效性: 深度由重建网格渲染；单位、截断、径向距离或 Z、分辨率属于仿真与导出协议，需逐项记录。
zh.场景质量: 静态扫描保留实测纹理；反光表面和细结构可能存在几何瑕疵。
zh.评测协议: GibsonV2 全场景包与质量筛选 4+ 包不同，需注明子集和场景级划分，并排除与 Pano3D 测试资产重叠。
zh.位姿与时间: 仿真轨迹提供参考位姿，不是独立动捕真值；物理同步不属于场景资产本身的属性。

en: Gibson static scenes and interactive iGibson scene/object assets are different products.
zh: Gibson 静态场景与交互式 iGibson 场景、物体资产属于不同产品。

evidence.title: Official current static-scene download and scan caveats

name: HM3D
title: Habitat-Matterport 3D Dataset: 1000 Large-scale 3D Environments for Embodied AI

license.en: Free for academic non-commercial research under HM3D/Matterport access terms.
license.zh: 依 HM3D、Matterport 获取条款供学术非商业研究免费使用。

summary.en: Building-scale real scene meshes for embodied simulation; depth training pairs must be rendered under a declared camera protocol.
summary.zh: 面向具身仿真的建筑级真实场景网格；深度训练图像对需依据明确的相机协议另行渲染。

en.Release and projection: The official release is 3D scene scans, not fixed RGB-D videos or native ERP depth pairs. Perspective is a simulation use case; ERP is not claimed here.
en.Depth and validity: Depth derives from simulator geometry. Resolution, camera model, units, clipping, range/Z and invalid masks must be specified by the generated benchmark.
en.Reference poses: Rendered camera poses are generated references. They do not establish physical IMU timing or independent trajectory ground truth.
en.Evaluation: Respect official train/validation scene identities. Official metadata says test scenes are held out and not publicly released.
en.Quality and access: Scene-quality ratings and navigability metadata aid filtering. Download depends on Matterport research access; asset quality is not sensor-depth accuracy.

zh.发布与投影: 官方发布为三维场景扫描，不是固定 RGB-D 视频或原生 ERP 深度对。透视属于仿真用途，此条不声称自带 ERP。
zh.深度与有效性: 深度来自仿真几何；生成基准必须注明分辨率、相机模型、单位、截断、径向距离或 Z 及无效掩码。
zh.参考位姿: 渲染相机位姿是生成参考，不代表包含物理 IMU 时间或独立轨迹真值。
zh.评测协议: 遵守官方训练、验证场景身份；官方元数据说明测试场景保留，不公开发布。
zh.质量与获取: 场景质量评分与可通行元数据可辅助筛选；下载依赖 Matterport 研究访问权限，资产质量不等同于传感器深度精度。

en: Keep HM3D distinct from Matterport3D and HM3D-Semantics annotation releases.
zh: HM3D、Matterport3D 与 HM3D-Semantics 标注发布需分别记录。

evidence.title: Official scope, access and scene-split metadata

name: DIODE
title: DIODE: A Dense Indoor and Outdoor DEpth Dataset

license.en: MIT for dataset and code according to the official page.
license.zh: 官方页面注明数据与代码均为 MIT。

summary.en: Dense laser-derived depth across indoor/outdoor scenes, released as rectified perspective crops rather than full panoramas.
summary.zh: 覆盖室内外的稠密激光深度，以校正透视裁剪图发布，并非整幅全景。

en.Projection and inputs: 1024×768 RGB crops, 60° horizontal ×45° vertical FOV, extracted from scanner panoramas. Full scanner capture does not imply a public ERP benchmark.
en.Depth and validity: NumPy depth and binary validity arrays; mask 1 means valid return. Paper derives samples along scanner rays; range/Z should be checked before reprojection.
en.Measurement and timing: FARO laser measurements provide depth; RGB is collected after the scan, so moving objects can disagree despite manual curation.
en.Calibration and annotations: Official devkit supplies camera intrinsics and normal/metric utilities. Normals are derived from neighboring 3D samples.
en.Evaluation: Public train/validation depth and normals are documented; do not treat validation as unseen test after tuning. Keep crops from the same scan together.

zh.投影与输入: 从扫描器全景提取 1024×768 RGB 裁剪图，水平 60°、垂直 45°；扫描过程为全景不代表公开版本是 ERP 基准。
zh.深度与有效性: NumPy 深度与二值有效掩码，1 表示有效回波。论文沿扫描射线生成样本，重投影前仍需核对径向距离与 Z 约定。
zh.测量与时间: FARO 激光测量提供深度；RGB 在扫描后采集，尽管经过人工筛选，动态物体仍可能造成不一致。
zh.标定与标注: 官方工具提供相机内参、法向及评测工具，法向由邻域三维采样估计。
zh.评测协议: 官方明确发布训练、验证深度和法向；调参后不能把验证集称为未见测试集，同一扫描的裁剪图应保持同组。

en: Laser maximum range specifications are not a guarantee that every image pixel has valid depth.
zh: 激光器最大量程指标不保证每个图像像素均有有效深度。

evidence.title: Official downloads, masks, resolution and MIT license
Official paper: perspective extraction and scan timing

name: NYU Depth V2
title: Indoor Segmentation and Support Inference from RGBD Images

license.en: Public downloads; a dataset-wide license was not stated on the inspected official overview. Check archive terms before reuse.
license.zh: 可公开下载；本次核对的官方概览未注明统一数据许可，使用前需核对压缩包条款。

summary.en: Standard indoor perspective RGB-D baseline; measured rawDepths and inpainted depths must be kept separate.
summary.zh: 标准室内透视 RGB-D 基线；需严格区分实测 rawDepths 与补全后的 depths。

en.Projection and inputs: Kinect RGB/depth videos plus synchronized labeled RGB-D pairs in a MATLAB file; not fisheye or ERP.
en.Depth and validity: Both depths and aligned rawDepths are expressed in meters. depths fills missing values; rawDepths preserves holes before filling.
en.Ground truth: Structured-light sensor depth and semantic/instance labels. Inpainted pixels are processed supervision, not additional physical measurements.
en.Timing and calibration: Raw RGB and depth streams are unsynchronized with varying 20–30 FPS; timestamps and toolbox synchronization/calibration functions are supplied.
en.Evaluation: Disclose labeled/raw training subset, official split file, crop, depth cap and mask. Avoid using held-out scene raw frames for training.

zh.投影与输入: Kinect RGB、深度视频及 MATLAB 文件中的同步标注 RGB-D 图像对，不是鱼眼或 ERP。
zh.深度与有效性: depths 与对齐后的 rawDepths 均以米表示；depths 填补缺失值，rawDepths 保留补全前空洞。
zh.真值来源: 结构光传感器深度与语义实例标注；补全像素属于处理后监督，不是新增物理测量。
zh.时间与标定: 原始 RGB、深度不同步，帧率在 20–30 FPS 间变化；提供时间戳、同步及标定工具。
zh.评测协议: 说明标注、原始训练子集、划分文件、裁剪、深度上限和掩码；不能用留出场景的原始帧训练。

en: Accelerometer values do not make this a fully calibrated IMU/VIO benchmark with independent pose GT.
zh: 包含加速度计数据不代表它是具备独立位姿真值和完整 IMU 标定的 VIO 基准。

evidence.title: Official raw/labeled depth, timing and calibration

name: KITTI Depth
title: Sparsity Invariant CNNs / KITTI Depth Prediction and Completion

license.en: KITTI download registration and dataset terms apply; evaluation submissions have separate eligibility rules.
license.zh: 适用 KITTI 下载注册及数据条款，评测提交另有资格限制。

summary.en: Outdoor perspective benchmark with LiDAR-derived targets; official prediction/completion and common Eigen-style splits are different protocols.
summary.zh: 采用激光派生目标的室外透视基准；官方预测、补全与常见 Eigen 式划分是不同协议。

en.Projection and inputs: Depth maps align with KITTI raw left/right perspective images; raw LiDAR and corresponding RGB are separate inputs.
en.Depth and validity: Depth targets combine LiDAR observations; they remain sparse/occlusion-sensitive. Verify PNG scaling and valid-pixel rules in the downloaded official devkit.
en.Calibration: Use raw-data camera/LiDAR calibration and frame mapping. A depth benchmark is not a replacement for odometry ground truth.
en.Evaluation: Separate depth prediction (RGB) from depth completion (RGB plus sparse depth). Specify split, crop, depth cap and scale alignment explicitly.
en.Access: Official downloads require login. Hidden test targets are evaluated by the benchmark; site eligibility rules restrict routine submissions.

zh.投影与输入: 深度图对应 KITTI 原始左右透视图，原始激光与对应 RGB 需分别加载。
zh.深度与有效性: 深度目标融合激光观测，仍受稀疏性与遮挡影响；PNG 缩放和有效像素规则需以下载的官方工具为准。
zh.标定: 需用原始相机、激光标定及帧映射；深度基准不能代替里程计位姿真值。
zh.评测协议: 区分深度预测（RGB）与深度补全（RGB 加稀疏深度），明确划分、裁剪、深度上限及尺度对齐。
zh.获取方式: 官方下载需登录；隐藏测试标签由官方评测，常规提交受网站资格规则约束。

en: A KITTI score cannot be directly compared with KITTI-360 fisheye or panoramic evaluation.
zh: KITTI 分数不能与 KITTI-360 鱼眼或全景评测直接比较。

name: WoodScape
title: WoodScape: A Multi-Task, Multi-Camera Fisheye Dataset for Autonomous Driving

zh: 未列出已发布稠密深度

license.en: Proprietary dataset agreement; repository MIT explicitly covers code only.
license.zh: 数据适用专有协议；仓库 MIT 明确仅适用于代码。

summary.en: Real surround fisheye RGB and previous frames support self-supervised geometry research; public dense-depth GT is not established by the release README.
summary.zh: 真实环视鱼眼 RGB 与前一帧可支持自监督几何研究；发布说明未确立公开的稠密深度真值。

en.Projection and inputs: Front, rear, mirror-left and mirror-right fisheye cameras. RGB, previous images, per-image calibration and CAN information are listed.
en.Depth availability: Released content lists semantic/instance/motion labels and boxes, not dense depth maps. LiDAR/dGPS scenes remain marked coming soon in this README.
en.Use in depth research: Suitable as fisheye image-pair input for self-supervised objectives; do not report supervised metric-depth accuracy without a separate released GT source.
en.Calibration and timing: Calibration and vehicle information are provided, but do not assume previous frames form fully synchronized multi-camera SLAM sequences.
en.Evaluation: Respect held-out test samples and camera/sequence identities. State the actual available task labels, rather than planned paper modalities.

zh.投影与输入: 包含前、后、左后视、右后视鱼眼相机；列出 RGB、前一帧、逐图标定及 CAN 信息。
zh.深度可用性: 已发布内容列有语义、实例、运动标签与框，未列稠密深度。此 README 的 LiDAR、dGPS 场景仍标为即将发布。
zh.深度研究用途: 可作为鱼眼图像对用于自监督目标；若无额外公开真值，不能报告有监督公制深度精度。
zh.标定与时间: 提供标定与车辆信息，但不能假定前一帧构成完全同步的多相机 SLAM 序列。
zh.评测协议: 遵守留出测试样本及相机、序列身份；注明实际可用标签，而不是论文计划提供的模态。

en: This is included as a fisheye depth-learning input source, explicitly not as a confirmed dense-depth GT benchmark.
zh: 此条作为鱼眼深度学习输入来源收录，明确不作为已确认具备稠密深度真值的基准。

evidence.title: Official released tasks, camera IDs, calibration and data license

name: Deep360
title: MODE: Multi-view Omnidirectional Depth Estimation with 360° Cameras

license.en: Repository BSD-3-Clause is code licensing; an explicit dataset-wide license was not verified from the overview.
license.zh: 仓库 BSD-3-Clause 属代码许可；概览未核实明确的数据集统一许可。

summary.en: Synthetic outdoor multi-view panoramas with depth/disparity and a soiled-lens variant for mud, droplets and glare.
summary.zh: 合成室外多视全景，配套深度、视差及泥点、水滴、眩光污染镜头版本。

en.Projection and inputs: CARLA-generated multi-camera road panoramas; the paper uses four 360° views. Preserve camera placement/baseline from the archive README.
en.Depth and validity: Rendered depth and disparity are separate targets. File scale, range convention and invalid masks must follow archive README and official dataloader.
en.Splits: Official repository lists 2100 train, 300 validation and 600 test frames across six episode archives; preserve the provided partitions.
en.Robustness evaluation: Clean and soiled versions share underlying scenes; never put one version in training and its counterpart in test.
en.Calibration and access: Known synthetic geometry provides stereo scale; it is not a measured real-rig benchmark. Official Drive folder and checksums are published.

zh.投影与输入: CARLA 生成多相机道路全景；论文使用四路 360° 视图，需保留压缩包说明中的相机布局和基线。
zh.深度与有效性: 渲染深度与视差是不同目标；文件缩放、距离约定与无效掩码必须按压缩包说明及官方加载器处理。
zh.数据划分: 官方列出 2100 训练、300 验证、600 测试帧，分为六个片段压缩包；应保留现成划分。
zh.鲁棒性评测: 干净和污染版本共享源场景，不能把同帧不同版本分别放入训练和测试。
zh.标定与获取: 已知合成几何提供立体尺度，不是真实装置实测基准；官方发布 Drive 文件夹与校验和。

en: Depth360 (SegFuse) and Deep360 (MODE) are different datasets despite similar names.
zh: Depth360（SegFuse）与 Deep360（MODE）名称相近但为不同数据集。

evidence.title: Official dataset structure, splits and download
Author paper with CARLA data generation

name: ToF-360
title: ToF-360: A Panoramic Time-of-flight RGB-D Dataset for Single Capture Indoor Semantic 3D Reconstruction

license.en: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 according to the official Hugging Face card.
license.zh: 官方 Hugging Face 数据卡标注 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0。

summary.en: Real panoramic ToF RGB-D measurements released as ERP products derived from dual-fisheye capture; a downloadable raw fisheye modality is not verified. Depth is measured per capture rather than rendered from a global mesh.
summary.zh: 真实全景 ToF RGB-D 测量，以双鱼眼采集转换的 ERP 产品发布；尚未核实可下载的原始鱼眼模态。深度来自每次测量，而非全局网格渲染。

en.Projection and inputs: Paper describes 5792×2896 ERP color/depth/XYZ products and raw fisheye capture. Bottom blind regions require masking.
en.Depth and validity: 16-bit PNG radial distance: meters = value / 512; zero means missing. XYZ NumPy data uses millimeter precision.
en.Ground truth: ToF sensor measurements, with normals, XYZ/HHA products and manual pixel semantics/layout. No independent continuous trajectory GT is claimed.
en.Evaluation: The official card lists 179 ERP images across four scenes; the workshop paper reports a different collection total. Pin the actual release and scene split.
en.Calibration: Use the supplied fisheye-to-ERP processing and pixel-aligned products; do not apply a pinhole Z backprojection to radial ERP depth.

zh.投影与输入: 论文描述 5792×2896 ERP 彩色、深度、XYZ 产品与原始鱼眼采集；底部盲区需掩码处理。
zh.深度与有效性: 16 位 PNG 存径向距离：米数＝数值 / 512，0 表示缺失；XYZ NumPy 数据具有毫米精度。
zh.真值来源: ToF 传感器测量，提供法向、XYZ、HHA 及人工逐像素语义、布局；此条不声称含独立连续轨迹真值。
zh.评测协议: 官方卡片列四个场景、179 幅 ERP 图，而研讨会论文报告的采集总数不同；评测需固定具体发布与场景划分。
zh.标定: 使用配套鱼眼转 ERP 处理与像素对齐产品，不能用针孔 Z 反投影处理 ERP 径向深度。

en: Useful for real panoramic depth/domain transfer; its original benchmarks emphasize semantics and layout.
zh: 可用于真实全景深度和域迁移，原论文基准主要强调语义与布局。

evidence.title: Official data card: units, masks and license

name: Holo360D
title: Holo360D: A Large-Scale Real-World Dataset with Continuous Trajectories for Advancing Panoramic 3D Reconstruction and Beyond

zh: 含 IMU / RTK-GNSS 的采集装置

license.en: Repository code has MIT; the inspected dataset card has no explicit dataset license metadata. Confirm data terms with authors before redistribution.
license.zh: 仓库代码为 MIT；核对的数据卡未注明明确数据许可元信息，重新分发前需向作者确认数据条款。

summary.en: Continuous real indoor/outdoor panoramas with LiDAR-derived mesh/point-cloud depth and refined poses; official full data release is available.
summary.zh: 连续真实室内外全景，提供激光派生网格、点云深度和优化位姿，官方已发布完整数据。

en.Projection and inputs: 360° camera records 5760×2880 panoramas at 24 FPS; published archives separate RGB, mesh_depth, pointcloud_depth, masks and poses.
en.Depth and validity: Mesh depth is camera-center Euclidean distance, EXR; point depth uses mesh visibility filtering. Numeric unit/mask encoding should be confirmed in loaders.
en.Ground truth provenance: LiDAR, online/offline SLAM and bundle adjustment produce references; meshes undergo denoising and hole filling. Poses are not independent motion-capture GT.
en.Timing and calibration: Scanner and rigidly mounted camera share software start/stop triggering. Do not infer that all raw IMU/RTK streams are included in RGB-D archives.
en.Evaluation and versions: Paper uses scene-disjoint 60/15 train/test; release news describes a different initial test grouping. Pin release scene lists; re-download test masks predating July 2026 fix.

zh.投影与输入: 360° 相机以 24 FPS 记录 5760×2880 全景；发布包分开存储 RGB、mesh_depth、pointcloud_depth、掩码和位姿。
zh.深度与有效性: 网格深度是相机中心欧氏距离，以 EXR 存储；点云深度利用网格处理可见性。数值单位和掩码编码需进一步核对加载器。
zh.真值来源: 参考值来自激光、在线离线 SLAM 与束调整，网格经去噪和补洞；位姿并非独立动捕真值。
zh.时间与标定: 扫描器与刚性安装相机共享软件启停触发；不能据此推断 RGB-D 压缩包包含所有原始 IMU、RTK 流。
zh.评测与版本: 论文采用场景隔离的 60/15 训练测试划分，发布新闻的初始测试分组不同。需固定场景清单，旧测试掩码应更新至 2026 年 7 月修正版。

en: Mesh-filled regions and point-cloud-supported pixels provide different supervision; report which target and mask were used.
zh: 网格补洞区域与点云实测支持像素提供不同监督，需报告所用目标与掩码。

Paper: range definition, timing, refinement and scene splits
